russia_2010.label: Russia, summer 2010
russia_2010.basis: ERA5 TempestExtremes catalogue block 881 (2010-07-22 03 UTC to 08-13 19 UTC); Z500 minus zonal mean up to 302 m near 60N 46E on 2010-08-06

atlantic_2019.label: North Atlantic, summer 2019
atlantic_2019.basis: ERA5 TempestExtremes catalogue block 1312 (2019-07-21 19 UTC to 08-05 08 UTC); Z500 minus zonal mean up to 348 m near 67N 17E on 2019-07-27, then near 73N 15W

pacific_nw_2021.label: Pacific Northwest heat dome, 2021
pacific_nw_2021.basis: Wikipedia heat-wave dates 2021-06-25 to 07-07; Z500 minus zonal mean above 200 m near 53N 120-130W from 06-25 to 07-03

california_2025.label: California wildfires, January 2025
california_2025.basis: Wikipedia fire dates 2025-01-07 to 01-31 (Santa Ana windstorm 01-07 to 01-08); Z500 minus zonal mean above 300 m near 45N 130W from 01-07 to 01-16 (415 m on 01-09)

greenland_2026.label: Greenland high, January 2026 winter storm
greenland_2026.basis: Wikipedia storm dates 2026-01-23 to 01-27; Z500 minus zonal mean 210-250 m near 74N 15W from 01-23 to 01-25
